actualInspection.notes: Actually inspected all30final terrain images:six cameras across master and four browser levels. Public Thüringen DGM1 retains exact1mXYZ crop,November2022 airborne laser capture,EPSG25832/EPSG7837,GCG2016 and documented.15–.30m vertical accuracy. Bilinear reprojection yields a3m native fixture relative to Hofburg[-20,0],406.905m DHHN2016. The southern court descends about3.3m,the keep court rises2.7m,northern entrance falls5.3m. The photographic working range floors and gallery gradients remain separate from bare-earth interpolation under roofs. Foundations extend below retained slopes with minimum edge sampling. Three probes at actual grid vertices show.015m clearance and check signed coordinate/datum integration; horizontal rays independently test the occupied walls of Palas,keep,SouthTower,Vogtei and east gallery. Five unload cycles each leave0model geometries. No terrain hill is duplicated,no whole-court ground cutout is imposed. Skyline/district intentionally omit the stair and facade ornament; street/close restore them. The steep eastern/northern cliff is host terrain,not asset geometry. Fine paving,retaining steps and doorway floor elevations remain reconstructed; host terrain must provide comparable site detail.
